name: flame blade
lore:
# On the Manifestation of the Flame Blade

To call forth the *Flame Blade* is to command the very breath of the sun. As the incantation concludes, the practitioner feels the Weave constrict around their grip, not with the cold bite of iron, but with a vibrant, pulsating friction—as if grasping a captured solar flare.

Visually, the spell manifests as a beam of concentrated fury. It does not merely burn; it hums with a low, rhythmic thrum, its edges flickering like the tongue of a hungry salamander while the core glows with a steady, blinding crimson. It possesses the weight of a physical saber, yet leaves no ash, only cauterized air.

Legend attributes its genesis to the Sun-Walker Kaelen. Trapped within the Glacial Tombs of the North, Kaelen found his steel shattered by frost-giants. Refusing to yield, he reached into the Leylines of the Summer Solstice, pulling a thread of pure heat into his empty palm. He did not just survive; he carved a path through the permafrost, leaving behind glass-scarred earth and the first recorded rite of this searing discipline.
